newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police grab two helicopter robbery suspects.
newsitem.headline: German police grab two helicopter robbery suspects.

text.p: German police detained two suspects on Thursday in connection with a bank robbery in which a gunman made a getaway by helicopter with more than one million marks ($625,000).
The two suspects, a man and a woman, were detained after a police raid on a house in the southern town of Bamberg, a police spokesman said.

The robber posed as a normal customer to make an appointment with the manager of the bank in Offenburg, near the French border, on Wednesday. He pulled a machine gun and forced the manager to hand over the money.
He then made a call on his mobile phone and the helicopter arrived outside shortly afterwards.
Police said the man and his accomplice had hired the helicopter in the city of Mannheim and then forced the pilot to fly to Offenburg.
The helicopter and the pilot, who was unharmed, were later found in nearby countryside.
